title: GAIN (Digitone effect)
author: irpina
description: GAIN, the smallest effect on fxkit for the Digitone mk1: a level, a tone and the right side's phase on the inputs. GAIN in core-dn1's Mod Menu (hold a track key) makes it the active effect (the synths muted) and opens its page: SYN1 its knobs, AMP fxkit's mixer, LFO its two LFOs, RECORD the LOCK mode (hold a trig, turn a knob: a p-lock on that step), MIDI the stock UI for the MIDI tracks while it plays, NO off. A template for an effect mod: it names no firmware address, so its OS 1.44 port is empty (docs/ADAPTING.md, "fxkit"). Needs fxkit.
